clue.text: When he drives, Dr Hill is on time

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor
a tor is a rocky hill
taken as written

explanation.surface: A doctor called Hill keeps strict time whenever he is behind the wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dr Hill' looks like one person's name, but it splits into two pieces: the doctor and the hill.
explanation.definitionFit: A car driver is the person at the wheel, so 'he' when he drives describes one.

clue.text: Woe is me!- wrong lines

indicators.note: wrong suggests the two words is and me are set out incorrectly, so their letters get rearranged

parts.note: RY, railway, is crossword shorthand for lines

explanation.surface: A cry of self-pity complains that the lines have been laid out wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation mark makes 'Woe is me!' look like one cry, but only 'Woe' defines; 'wrong' is the anagram signal for the next two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Woe is deep sorrow or unhappiness, a synonym of the answer.

clue.text: Trip around Rhode Island Pass is standard

indicators.note: around tells us the word for trip is wrapped about the following pieces

parts.note: a tour is a trip
RI is the abbreviation for the US state Rhode Island
a col is a mountain pass

explanation.surface: Touring round Rhode Island, a visitor finds that crossing the pass is the normal thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link word; 'standard' is a flag, not a norm.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a flag, and a three-coloured national flag such as France's is a common one.

clue.text: Country dialects have a peculiar effect on nice large cats

indicators.note: having a peculiar effect on the words that follow means their letters are thrown into an odd new order

explanation.surface: Rural ways of speaking seem to have a strange influence on handsome big cats.
explanation.walkthrough: The word 'on' looks like part of the phrase 'effect on' but is fodder: ON, NICE, LARGE and CATS together give the fifteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ways of speaking particular to provinces or country districts are local speech patterns.

clue.text: Some doubt about small relative gathering mushrooms

indicators.note: gathering means the word for the relative holds the mushrooms within it

parts.note: sis is a short, small form of sister, a relative
ceps are edible boletus mushrooms

explanation.surface: A doubtful note about a young sister collecting mushrooms in the woods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathering' puts the mushrooms just after the first letter of the relative's name. 'about' is only a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the philosophical term for sceptical doubt, the suspension of belief.

clue.text: Comes of tendency to conceal temper

indicators.note: to conceal says the run of letters lies concealed inside the words Comes of tendency

explanation.surface: Losing your temper comes from a tendency to keep it bottled up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'temper' looks like a noun meaning anger, but it is the verb meaning moderate.
explanation.definitionFit: To temper something is to moderate or make it milder.

clue.text: Finished irrevocably behind one

definitions.meaning: completely ended with no going back
something put behind you is in the past and no longer your concern

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means completely finished, and a matter left behind you is likewise finished.

clue.text: The growth of impromptu liposuction

indicators.note: of signals the letters come from within the words impromptu liposuction

explanation.surface: Weight gained after a quick, unplanned bout of liposuction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'growth' looks like a medical lump in this setting, but it is a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulb flower is a plant that grows, hence a growth.

clue.text: Give consent — say you don't win; knotty, that

parts.note: to nod is to give consent

indicators.note: say means the next word is spoken, giving only its sound

parts.note: the word you sounds like the letter U
to lose is not to win

explanation.surface: Agreeing to a game and admitting you will not win makes for a tangled situation.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanically the word means covered in small knots or nodules, so knobbly or knotty.

clue.text: Tom the woodcutter

definitions.meaning: Mark Twain's boy hero Tom has this surname
a person who saws timber for a living

explanation.definitionFit: Twain's Tom shares the name, and a timber-sawing worker bears the same title.

clue.text: Smart rip-off

definitions.meaning: to smart is to feel a ... pain
a swindle or con, as in being overcharged

explanation.definitionFit: A sharp pain smarts, and a confidence trick or swindle is the slang sense.

clue.text: Gibson Girl in front was first to be painted

indicators.note: in front says the girl's name goes ahead of Gibson's

parts.note: Ena is a girl's name
Mel Gibson is the actor
to have led is to have been first

explanation.surface: A girl ahead of Gibson in a line was the first one to have her portrait painted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gibson Girl' looks like the famous Edwardian illustrated beauty, but it splits into the actor and a girl's name, with 'in front' moving the girl ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Something enamelled has been coated with a glossy paint-like finish.

clue.text: King, one you lost playing wildly

parts.note: R is from Rex, Latin for king
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of you lost are sporting about in a new order

explanation.surface: A king tells someone that they lost while playing in an uncontrolled way.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in an unruly, unrestrained way is acting wildly.

clue.text: Dismay a returning reindeer herdsman

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: returning means the word for the herdsman is read backwards

parts.note: the Lapps of northern Scandinavia are traditionally reindeer herders

explanation.surface: A reindeer herder comes back home, to everyone's alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismay someone is to shock or horrify them.

clue.text: High standards required for exam in writing

indicators.note: in places the exam inside the abbreviation for writing

parts.note: MS, manuscript, is a piece of writing
an oral is a spoken exam

explanation.surface: Strict rules apply when the exam has to be taken in writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in writing' looks like the form the exam takes, but 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Principles of right conduct are ethical standards.

clue.text: Make amends for cover-up -again

parts.note: re- means again
to dress is to cover up with clothes

explanation.surface: Apologising for a scandal by trying to hush it up once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover-up' looks like a scandal being hidden, but it is clothing put on.
explanation.definitionFit: To set right or compensate for a wrong is to make amends.

clue.text: Frenchman standing up to soldiers, the man's raring 'to go

annotationWithheld.why: Frenchman standing up to soldiers, the man's raring 'to go: RENE reversed (ENER) + GIS gives ENERGIS, but nothing standard makes ED of 'the man's'; likely OCR damage, no source found
annotationWithheld.clue: Frenchman standing up to soldiers, the man's raring 'to go

clue.text: The runner in the new Lugger manuscript turns up first

indicators.note: first says this piece leads the answer
in a down clue turning up means the abbreviation is read from the bottom upwards
new implies a fresh arrangement of the letters of Lugger

explanation.surface: A new manuscript about a lugger names the runner in the story.
explanation.walkthrough: SM comes first, then UGGLER, the anagram of LUGGER. A lugger is a small sailing boat, apt for contraband.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner is someone who carries contraband, as in rum-runner.

clue.text: In Kent, a king once retreated in defeat

indicators.note: in puts the reversed pieces inside the word for defeat

parts.note: mate, as in checkmate, is defeat

indicators.note: retreated means the pieces go backwards

parts.note: taken as written
GR, Georgius Rex, is a former king's title

explanation.surface: A Kentish king of old fell back after a defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a seaside town in Kent, England; 'once' marks GR as a past king's cipher.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a resort town on the north coast of the county, so a place found in Kent.

clue.text: In French, with German unknown, there's ill-feeling

parts.note: en is French for in
mit is German for with
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: Mixing French and German with an unknown quantity breeds bad blood.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostility or animosity is ill-feeling.

clue.text: Smashed? Happen our kid will know

parts.note: Northern English slang for a brother, so bro
ken is Scots and Northern for know

explanation.surface: A Northerner suggests their younger brother will know what got broken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Happen' is Northern English for perhaps, and 'our kid' is Northern for one's brother; both set the dialect scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Something shattered into pieces is broken.

clue.text: Bishop with flowers for the tackers

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
asters are daisy-like flowers

explanation.surface: A bishop brings flowers for the people who fix things in place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flowers' are blooms here, not rivers; 'tackers' sew loose temporary stitches.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewers who tack fabric with long loose stitches are doing the same job.

clue.text: Otherwise fine writer

parts.note: or means otherwise
well means fine, in good health

explanation.surface: A writer who would otherwise be perfectly good.
explanation.definitionFit: George Orwell was the English novelist who wrote Animal Farm.

clue.text: Officer in charge of DNA unit

parts.note: Gen is the abbreviation for General, an officer

explanation.surface: An officer is placed in charge of a genetics laboratory unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unit' looks like a military one, but the DNA unit is a gene.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means relating to genes, and genes are units of DNA.

clue.text: Sneaks poles out of old vessel

indicators.note: out of places the two poles on the outside of the vessel

parts.note: N and S are the north and south poles
Noah's Ark is an ancient vessel

explanation.surface: Informers slip the poles off an ancient ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Narks are informers, or sneaks who tell tales.

clue.text: Germs seen disturbingly as a forerunner

indicators.note: disturbingly suggests the letters of germs seen are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Germs that are seen in an alarming way herald an epidemic.
explanation.definitionFit: A herald who goes ahead with news is a forerunner.

clue.text: Artificial leg to rent; need glasses

definitions.note: plural in the clue, but the answer is one pair of spectacles on a handle

indicators.note: artificial means made up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man with a prosthetic leg to hire also needs spectacles.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a pair of spectacles held up by a long handle.

clue.text: Spring denouement

explanation.definitionFit: To spring is to emerge, and a denouement is a final outcome.

clue.text: Stand out against island in relief

indicators.note: in puts the island abbreviation inside the word for relief

parts.note: rest is relief from work

explanation.surface: An island stands out sharply against a relief map.
explanation.definitionFit: To withstand or oppose firmly is to stand out against.

clue.text: Snake carrier sending back the French flower

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake
a hod is a builder's carrier for bricks

indicators.note: sending back means the French article is turned round

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: A snake handler returns a French flower.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a lily-like plant, the flower of the Elysian fields.
